description: Source code for a Go package that retrieves and constructs a string describing the operating system release based on os-release files, supporting multiple Unix-like systems.

methods.name: osRelease
methods.description: Builds a string describing the OS release based on os-release file properties.

methods.name: getOSReleaseFile
methods.description: Returns a file pointer to the first available os-release file from a list.

methods.name: parseOSReleaseFile
methods.description: Parses the os-release file and returns a map of key-value pairs.

methods.name: skip
methods.description: Determines if a line should be skipped (empty or comment).

methods.name: parse
methods.description: Splits a line into key and value, unquoting and unescaping the value.

methods.name: unquote
methods.description: Removes surrounding quotes from a string if present.

methods.name: unescape
methods.description: Removes escape characters from a string.

methods.name: buildOSRelease
methods.description: Constructs a descriptive OS release string from key-value properties.
